Name: Chest Pooling V2
Author: jpslatt
Description:
[b]Chest Pooling

[/b]inspired by [url=https://github.com/mralbobo/stardew-chest-pooling]Chest Pooling[/url]﻿

This mod is designed to enhance your inventory management by automatically depositing your items into the chest that already contains the most of that particular item.In the event that the item does not exist in any other chest, it will simply be stored in the current chest. This functionality allows for a quick organization of your chests, without any complex configuration.

I mostly did this because I wanted to use it myself and it was outdated. Then I realized it could be simplified

[b][url=https://github.com/jslattery26/stardew_mods/tree/main/ChestPoolingV2]Contribute[/url][/b]
